source: User-specified fundraiser base rates (2026-10-10 events-r1.json). Authoritative default for this simulation; values are the user's exact set.

base_rates.event: Investor replies to a cold first-touch outreach (email, SMS or LinkedIn)
base_rates.applies_when: first contact with no warm introduction

base_rates.event: Investor replies to a warm-introduction or referred outreach
base_rates.applies_when: a mutual contact introduced or referred Rose Labs

base_rates.event: Replying investor agrees to schedule a pitch meeting
base_rates.applies_when: the investor replied and the fund invests at seed stage

base_rates.event: Booked pitch meeting takes place as scheduled
base_rates.applies_when: a meeting time was confirmed by both sides

base_rates.event: Investor asks for a follow-up meeting or diligence materials after a pitch
Investor verbally commits to invest after a pitch meeting
base_rates.applies_when: a pitch meeting took place; the check size fits the investor's typical seed check, so roughly 200 meetings are needed to raise $5M

base_rates.event: Committed investor signs the SAFE by e-signature
base_rates.applies_when: the investor verbally committed and received the SAFE

base_rates.event: Committed investor's wire settles in Rose Labs' Brex account within one simulated business day
base_rates.applies_when: the SAFE is signed and wire instructions were sent
